signal: Great Question raised a $13M Series A led by Inovia and shipped an MCP in March 2026 to run research from AI tools like Claude and Cursor

email.body1:
Nick, saw Great Question closed its $13M Series A and shipped the MCP for running research from Claude and Cursor.

Post-raise, the bottleneck usually is not signal, it is the lag between a buying signal firing and a rep actually acting on it, which kills response rates. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up the moment a signal hits, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Great Question off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Nick, quick follow-up for Great Question.

Most RevOps leaders can see the leads stacking up but cannot prove where outbound leaks between signal, send, and CRM. That gap quietly caps how much pipeline the same team can produce.

Worth 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and three things I would change. Our best practices alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent.
email.body3:
Nick, last bit of proof for Great Question.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Great Question's reply rate likely compares to other Series-A startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Nick, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If tightening signal-to-action is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Right after a raise the RevOps backlog is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a Series-A ops motion? I will tailor it to Great Question either way.
